### Figma 

## Regestration flow 
1. Splash Screen
2. Language Selection
3. Onboarding
4. Role Selection
5. Login / Signup 
6. if Signup → OTP Verification 
7. if Login → Home Screen || forgot password flow 
8. if forgot password → OTP Verification → Reset Password
